comments.body:
## Summary

- 9 out of 12 PRs reviewed were merged.
- Remaining PRs for Pectra EIPs moving to Final will be reviewed asynchronously.
- EIP process was explained at [21:18](https://www.youtube.com/live/q2KPtJUmGHo&t=1278s) timestamp.

### Additional Highlights:
- Pooja initiated the meeting, welcomed attendees, and reviewed the agenda.
- Sam Wilson:
  - Walked through multiple EIP PRs and offered process guidance for finalization.
  - Offered to put ERC-7920 on the [agenda for wallet dev call](https://github.com/ethereum/pm/issues/1479).
  - Reviewed a new NFT standard supporting multiple owners.
  - Discussed proposal progress with authors providing constructive feedback.
  - Reviewed draft proposals covering:
    - Algorithm standards
    - Transaction wrappers
    - Margin token wrappers
    - A unified wrapper contract for streamlined usaget were discussed.

### Next steps

- Narcis to update the file name in PR # 999 on the ERC repository.
- Sam to add [ERC-7920](https://github.com/ethereum/pm/issues/1479) to the agenda for the upcoming wallet devs call.
- Authors of [EIP-7858]((https://github.com/ethereum/pm/issues/1479)) to update the last call deadline to the 27th and make formatting changes as suggested by Sam.
- Authors of [EIP-7291](https://github.com/ethereum/ERCs/pull/887) to address Sam's comments and make necessary changes before moving to Last Call.
- Authors of [EIP-7634](https://github.com/ethereum/ERCs/pull/983) to work on technical aspects of the proposal before moving to last call.
- Pooja to upload the agenda for the next meeting on the ethereum/pm repository.
